params.message:
A website hash in either form opens the page

The website module carries the dealer id encrypted in the address in two forms: as a string, and serialized in the search form and its dependent lists. The decryption was chosen per route, so a string hash on a search, model list or body style route decrypted fine and then failed in unserialize() with an ErrorException that the 404 of R S2-5.24 did not catch. dealerIdFromHash now always decrypts as a string and reads the serialized form of an id by pattern, on every route. Nothing a visitor sends is unserialized any more.
